nom: PEACH & LILY Bio Rice Wine Softening Toner

segments.oily: One reviewer with very oily skin reports the toner has not caused breakouts or sensitivity and gives a radiant, glowing result.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report relief from tightness, deep hydration and softness, with some saying they need only a cleanser plus this toner to feel comfortable through winter.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (including sensitive-combination) describe it as gentle, non-irritating, and leaving skin soft and matte rather than oily.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, report calming of redness and irritation with no new breakouts, though one sensitive-acne-prone combination reviewer felt results were unremarkable.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older or mature report hydration that softens the look of fine lines and crepey skin over weeks to months of use.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically identify normal skin as a category.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother, plumper-looking skin and less visible fine lines and crepiness with continued use over weeks to months; effects are described as gradual rather than immediate.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report improved hydration, softness and a non-tight feel, including several with chronically dry skin; one reviewer says hydration fades within an hour and needs layering with a heavier moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including two with rosacea, report the toner calms redness and irritation, with one noting redness returns when she stops using it; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the toner as gentle and non-irritating even on skin previously damaged by medical treatments or harsh toners, with soothing rather than stinging or tingling reported.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers mention reduced appearance of acne scarring and dark spots/uneven tone with continued use; effects are described as gradual.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne, PCOS-related bumps, or persistent blemishes report smoother, clearer skin and fewer breakouts; one reviewer reports increased acne with use and attributes it possibly to other products, and one sensitive-acne-prone reviewer saw no improvement in acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the toner does not add oiliness or greasiness, describing a soft matte finish even on combination and oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and serums
Insufficient hydration alone for very dry skin

extraits.texte: This is hydrating for my sensitive acne prone combination skin. It also makes my face feel soft without it feeling or looking oily. The product has not caused any irritation or acne. There is a faint alcohol smell from the fermentation, but it dissipates quickly. I like this, but I don't love it. The results aren't any better than other similar products that are half the price or less. I was hoping that it would see improvements with acne, but I did not. If you have dry skin, this probably won't be hydrating enough unless you layer it with other products. The glass bottle is a little small for the price and with little benefit except a bit of hydration, I will not repurchase.

I've struggled with the skin near my nose being red, irritated and flaky. Tried lots of products. I was definitely not expecting this toner to clear it up! When I ran out and went a couple of weeks without the toner, my skin started to get irritated and red again. right away when I started using the toner again it cleared up. Love it!!! leaves my skin extra clean, soft and glowy.
This stuff has helped transform my skin I have rosacea and it had helped calm it like crazy I have had people stoping me and asking me what I have been using

I waited to write a review because I wanted to make sure the toner performed over time. I've been using Peach and Lily exclusively for almost two years now and it's been a game changer. The pores on my nose have cleared considerably and are less noticeable in size. And my skin is so hydrated and smooth! I'm 53 so fine lines are a given, but my skin is hydrated enough that they aren't as deep as I know they'd have been. Mostly because I used nothing on my neck area until recently so I have a nice comparison (eep!). Also, the products are amazing for diminishing or holding at bay the crepe paper skin. When I first started using the products I noticed the beginnings around the corners of my mouth, and now there's nothing. This rice wine toner is the first thing I apply after washing my face, and it helps hydrate my skin. When I was younger I had an oily T-zone, but as I've aged my skin has gotten dryer everywhere. This brand of face care products has been the only one that hasn't inflamed my skin and caused breakouts or patches of flaking skin. I'm so grateful to have found it!Also, my cat LOVES this toner. She sits by the sink and waits for me to apply it then licks it off my face. I like to think it's proving how chemical free the product is, and not dwell on the fact that I'm enabling feline alcoholism. Cannot recommend this brand highly enough. I use a number of their products and my skin has never felt smoother. It also looks so much more vibrant and even toned than it did

I've purchased my second bottle of this toner recently--the first time I used it, I noticed such a great difference in my skin! There was more hydration and I noticed a difference in some of the acne scarring that I've had as well as helping with blemishes that weren't going away. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking to use a toner for sensitive skin to try!

Toners can be irritating on my skin. This product creates a smooth, hydrating canvas where my skin serums seep in (Numbuzin peptide and glutathione as well as Anua PDRN 100 cream). I only use concealer with some contour/highlights as my makeup with some powder in the T zone. It lasts all day and my skin looks plump—important since a dehydrated look accentuates fine lines ans wrinkles.
This toner changed my skin!!!! I have PCOS with some acne and tiny bumps on my skin. With this addition it finally made it nice and smooth. the clearest my skin has ever been.
